ruling.recommended_action: Uphold the $6.61 cancellation fee as valid (driver met all NS-1 conditions: arrival, >3 min wait at pickup); send the rider the GPS-verified timeline via RydeHELP and take no account action.

rejected_claims.reason: Rider states the driver cancelled a minute after he came out, but gps/timeline records show the driver was within 200 m from 13:01:10, stationary at the pickup 13:02:25–13:05:40, and cancelled at 13:05:40 — a 4 min 30 s presence and 3 min 15 s stationary wait [F2][F3][F5]. System records override the statement.
No Ryde rule grants a free cancellation for driver lateness; NS-8 is informational/non-citable and the dataset has no ETA field.
